titleEn: Maximum Number of Tasks You Can Assign
title: 你可以安排的最多任务数目
summary: 每名工人最多一项任务，可给至多 pills 名工人增加 strength，求最多可完成任务数。
insight: 完成任务数具有单调性，二分 k。检查时取最容易的 k 项和最强的 k 名工人，从最难任务向下处理：优先使用无需药丸的最弱可行工人，否则用药丸后的最弱可行工人。
pitfalls: 只需选择部分任务和工人
检查 k 时任务取最容易 k 个

solutions.title: 二分数量与工人多重集贪心
solutions.idea: 用有序工人集合为每项任务选择最弱足够者。
steps: check(k)：TreeMap 放最强 k 工人，task 从 k-1 降到零
先 ceiling(task)；没有则需 pill 并 ceiling(task-strength)，否则失败；消耗工人，二分最大可行 k

code.java: class Solution { int[] tasks,workers;int pills,strength;private void remove(TreeMap<Integer,Integer> map,int value){int count=map.get(value);if(count==1)map.remove(value);else map.put(value,count-1);}private boolean can(int count){TreeMap<Integer,Integer> available=new TreeMap<>();for(int i=workers.length-count;i<workers.length;i++)available.merge(workers[i],1,Integer::sum);int remainingPills=pills;for(int task=count-1;task>=0;task--){Integer worker=available.ceilingKey(tasks[task]);if(worker!=null)remove(available,worker);else{if(remainingPills==0)return false;worker=available.ceilingKey(tasks[task]-strength);if(worker==null)return false;remainingPills--;remove(available,worker);}}return true;}public int maxTaskAssign(int[] tasks,int[] workers,int pills,int strength){Arrays.sort(tasks);Arrays.sort(workers);this.tasks=tasks;this.workers=workers;this.pills=pills;this.strength=strength;int left=0,right=Math.min(tasks.length,workers.length);while(left<right){int middle=(left+right+1)/2;if(can(middle))left=middle;else right=middle-1;}return left;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private lateinit var tasks:IntArray;private lateinit var workers:IntArray;private var pills=0;private var strength=0;private fun remove(map:java.util.TreeMap<Int,Int>,value:Int){if(map[value]==1)map.remove(value) else map[value]=map[value]!!-1};private fun can(count:Int):Boolean{val available=java.util.TreeMap<Int,Int>();for(i in workers.size-count until workers.size)available[workers[i]]=(available[workers[i]]?:0)+1;var remainingPills=pills;for(task in count-1 downTo 0){var worker=available.ceilingKey(tasks[task]);if(worker!=null)remove(available,worker)else{if(remainingPills==0)return false;worker=available.ceilingKey(tasks[task]-strength)?:return false;remainingPills--;remove(available,worker)}};return true};fun maxTaskAssign(tasks:IntArray,workers:IntArray,pills:Int,strength:Int):Int{tasks.sort();workers.sort();this.tasks=tasks;this.workers=workers;this.pills=pills;this.strength=strength;var left=0;var right=minOf(tasks.size,workers.size);while(left<right){val middle=(left+right+1)/2;if(can(middle))left=middle else right=middle-1};return left} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<int> tasks,workers;int pills,strength;bool can(int count){multiset<int> available(workers.end()-count,workers.end());int remainingPills=pills;for(int task=count-1;task>=0;--task){auto worker=available.lower_bound(tasks[task]);if(worker!=available.end())available.erase(worker);else{if(!remainingPills)return false;worker=available.lower_bound(tasks[task]-strength);if(worker==available.end())return false;--remainingPills;available.erase(worker);}}return true;}public: int maxTaskAssign(vector<int>& tasks,vector<int>& workers,int pills,int strength){sort(tasks.begin(),tasks.end());sort(workers.begin(),workers.end());this->tasks=tasks;this->workers=workers;this->pills=pills;this->strength=strength;int left=0,right=min(tasks.size(),workers.size());while(left<right){int middle=(left+right+1)/2;if(can(middle))left=middle;else right=middle-1;}return left;} };
